output_list.reason: The mint function does not have a check to prevent overflow of the totalSupply, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens to any user, causing a denial of service to token holders.

The pullBack function does not have a check to prevent overflow of the totalSupply, allowing the owner to pull an arbitrary amount of tokens from any user, causing a denial of service to token holders.
The transferFrom function does not check if the balance of the _from address is sufficient to transfer the _value amount, allowing a locked user to be forced out of the system.
The approve function does not check if the spender address is not zero address, allowing the spender to be set to zero address, locking the owner's funds.
